name: Lisa
source: Lisa is the protagonist's younger sister. She is a sociable and cheerful girl. Although she was still grieving the loss of her parents, who had passed away a year before, she managed to keep her cheerful disposition. Lisa completed the first semester of her college program with outstanding academic performance. She is a member of the collegiate tennis team.
